description: A reasonably lightweight binary serialization library
Shiny Mediator - Avalonia integration (view/view model event collection, main thread, offline, persistent cache)
Serializes the complete state of .NET object graphs - including private fields, events and delegates - to JSON, and deserializes instances back fully functional.
Efficient reflection helpers used by TotalSerializer: cached member access, fast field/property readers and writers via emitted IL, and CLR type-name utilities.
